items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: I found out that we were supposed to play a battle against him. And at this time I was playing drums.

ctx.x: And Nat Cole took over the band. That still doesn't tell you what that band was. It was the high school band. It was the Booker T. Washington high school band.
Oh, I don't know, I'm not so sure where
